method: immutable-tag worktree; hybrid Search TopK=8; evidence windows serialized with the shared token estimator

rebaseline.reason: The lexical lane zero-hit bug was fixed: short words (1-2 chars) no longer apply an AND LIKE filter that silently zeroed whole queries (for example any question containing the word do). Cross-document and temporal queries now retrieve their full required evidence, so per-query contexts carry more correct evidence while staying inside their per-query budgets (135/135/135/102/135). Token growth is evidence recovery, not verbosity.
